"};
function decodeUtf8(base64){const raw=atob(base64),arr=new Uint8Array(raw.length);for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)arr[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(arr)}
function openPart(part){for(const name of ['home','one','two','three']){document.getElementById('view-'+name).classList.toggle('active',name===part);document.getElementById('nav-'+name).classList.toggle('active',name===part)}if(part!=='home'){const frame=document.getElementById('frame-'+part);if(!frame.dataset.loaded){frame.srcdoc=decodeUtf8(pages[part]);frame.dataset.loaded='true'}}window.scrollTo(0,0)}
</script></body></html>
